title: PlanReport
description: What a fanout planning pass leaves behind.

blockers.description: What prevents the planner from finding ready work.

questions.description: Questions only a human can answer.

summary.description:
What the planning pass found and why these units may proceed
independently.

units.description:
Independent work units. Each string is passed verbatim to one
child pipeline; tracker and frontier semantics live here, not
in the engine.

Question.description: A question the agent needs a human to answer before it can proceed.

id.description: The handle an answer is addressed to (`hako answer <run> <id>`).

options.description: Suggested answers; free-text is always allowed.

ReportStatus.description:
The agent's claim about where the loop stands. `done` is a claim,
not a verdict — the engine accepts it only after verify checks pass
and a skeptic iteration fails to refute it.
